questions.explanation: H equals 12/(N(N+1)) sum R_i^2/n_i - 3(N+1) equals 12/(15*16)*(2500/5+3600/5+5625/5) - 48 equals 12/240*2345 - 48? questions.topic: What the rank-sum null assumes about shape
questions.learningObjective: State the shape assumption of rank-sum
questions.stem: Note 50 asks what the rank-sum null assumes about the two distributions; which is correct?
questions.explanation: Rank-sum null assumes identical distributions except location. The tempting wrong idea is that it assumes normality or equal means.

questions.topic: The common-language reading of a rank sum
questions.stem: Note 54 asks for the common-language reading of a rank-sum result; which is correct?

options.text: Probability a random observation from one group exceeds one from the other

questions.explanation: Rank-sum estimates the probability one group's observation exceeds the other's. The tempting wrong idea is to read it as a mean difference.
